app.name: WiiCam
app.long_description:
Take photos and record video with a USB camera. It can record sound, too.
In testing, sound works at every resolution. However, it only stays available at the size the camera first opened with. To record sound at another size, restart WiiCam; the menu tells you when.
After a photo, or a video stopped with A, a review page opens: 1 plays the video back, and Minus twice deletes it.
Choose a size from 160 x 120 up to 848 x 480 (depending on the camera), set a 3, 5 or 10 second photo timer, or refresh the camera source from the menu.
Photos are saved to SD:/DCIM/100WC04 and videos to SD:/wc04-camera/videos. Videos are AVI files limited to 60 seconds or 128 MiB. Photos and videos can be viewed and edited in the Photo Channel.
Requires IOS58 and an SD card to save.
Tested with the Ubisoft Hercules WC04 camera (photos and silent video) and a W2 webcam, USB ID 0c45:6366 (photos, video and sound at every size). Other UVC 1.0 MJPEG cameras may work.
